Berezhnytsya Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Rivne Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. This record contains a discrepancy worth noting: local legend describes a possible second demolished Jewish cemetery at the site of a modern playground, though no map shows any cemetery there, casting doubt on this account. Based on matzevot remnants found in a local private yard, this cemetery already existed in the early 20th century; it appears on maps from the 1910s but not an 1870s Russian map, suggesting it emerged sometime between those dates. A separate, older Jewish cemetery is presumed to have stood at the site of the modern Christian cemetery on the village's western outskirts, based on an 1870s Russian map showing a Jewish cemetery there. According to local residents, this cemetery was destroyed in the 1950s.
